title.en: Yuji’s limited everyday angle

paragraphs.en: Yuji is a first-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High in the first-season setting. This edition takes a narrow editorial angle of joining someone for a manageable next step. It does not translate his supernatural situation or dramatic responsibilities into a statement about you. A preference for working alongside someone cannot establish selflessness, courage, empathy or willingness to sacrifice your own needs.
paragraphs.zh: 第一季背景里的悠仁是东京咒术高专一年级学生。本版只取“陪人做可完成的下一步”这个窄编辑角度，不把超自然处境或戏剧责任变成对你的陈述。喜欢并排做事，不能确立无私、勇气、共情或牺牲自身需要的意愿。

title.en: A cardboard model and one willing partner
title.zh: 纸板模型与一位自愿伙伴

paragraphs.en: A friend wants company while trying a cardboard model. You sit beside them, take one small piece of work and compare what happens on the next attempt. You need not finish the whole model or take over the difficult parts. Company can make trying something feel shared when the other person wants it; help that was not invited may be less useful.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友试纸板模型想有人陪，你坐在旁边接一小块工作，比较下一次怎么做。不必完成整个模型，也不必接管难处。对方愿意时，陪伴能让尝试有共同感；未经邀请的帮助可能没那么有用。

title.en: Company alongside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Megumi chooses which responsibility to accept, Nobara preserves a personal choice and Gojo tries a different way of seeing the task. Maki practises a concrete technique while Toge considers the effect of the words being used. Yuji’s angle joins the next attempt. These contributions can coexist, and several close guides do not reveal a hidden self or a ranking of who cares most.
paragraphs.zh: 惠选择承担哪项责任，野蔷薇保留个人选择，悟换角度看任务；真希练具体技法，棘考虑所用词语的影响。悠仁角度加入下一次尝试。贡献可共存，几份近分说明不揭示隐藏自我，也不排名谁更关心别人。

title.en: Company still needs consent and limits

paragraphs.en: Someone may want quiet space rather than a partner, and you may only have time for one attempt. Ask what would help and describe what you can offer. It is reasonable to stop or ask someone else to continue. A high count does not make you responsible for another person’s progress, and a lower count cannot establish indifference or a lack of loyalty.
paragraphs.zh: 有人可能更想安静做，你也可能只够陪一次。问什么有帮助，说清能提供什么；停下或请别人接力都合理。高计数不让你负责别人的进度，低计数也不确立冷漠或不忠诚。

title.en: Try a one-step offer
title.zh: 试一次只约一步的帮助

paragraphs.en: For one harmless hobby task, offer to try the next step together and let the other person decide. Agree what the step includes and when you will pause. Afterwards, ask whether the company was useful and notice your own experience too. This is feedback on a specific offer, not a test of goodness, resilience or how much you should give.
paragraphs.zh: 一次无害兴趣任务，提议只陪下一步，让对方选择。约好包含什么、何时暂停；之后问陪伴是否有用，也留意自己感受。这是具体帮助的反馈，不测善良、韧性，也不决定你该付出多少。

title.en: Megumi’s limited everyday angle

paragraphs.en: Megumi is a first-year student in the official first-season character setting, with protecting people he values part of his fictional motivation. This edition independently selects deliberation about a chosen commitment. It does not judge who deserves help or infer your self-worth, emotional life or history. A choice in an optional hobby task cannot establish the difficult beliefs or experiences attributed to a dramatic character.
paragraphs.zh: 官方第一季背景里的惠是一年级学生，保护自己重视的人是其虚构动机之一。本版独立选“考虑亲自选择的承诺”，不评谁值得帮助，也不推断你的自我价值、情绪生活或经历。可选兴趣任务里的选择，无法确立戏剧人物的艰难信念或体验。

title.en: Two invitations on one afternoon

paragraphs.en: Two creative projects ask for help, and you cannot comfortably do both. You consider what each commitment involves and tell people which part you genuinely want to take. A smaller, explicit offer can be more useful than an uncertain promise to do everything. You can choose neither if the available time does not fit; the result does not supply a duty to accept.
paragraphs.zh: 两个创作项目同时请帮忙，你无法舒服地全做。想清每项包含什么，再说真正愿接哪部分。小而明确的帮助，可能比含糊答应包办更有用。时间不合也可都不选；结果不提供必须接下的义务。

title.en: Deliberation beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Yuji joins a next step, Nobara keeps a personal expression and Gojo offers another frame for the task. Maki focuses on practice and Toge makes the message more deliberate. Megumi’s selected angle asks which responsibility you will actually own. These can improve the same plan without dividing people into caring and uncaring groups or turning an equal count into a hidden personality.
paragraphs.zh: 悠仁陪下一步，野蔷薇保留个人表达，悟换框架；真希专注练习，棘让表达更仔细。惠的选定角度问实际愿认领哪项责任。都可改善同一计划，不把人分成关心与不关心两类，也不把并列变成隐藏人格。

title.en: A careful choice can be communicated plainly
title.zh: 认真选择，也可明白说出

paragraphs.en: Thinking through a commitment need not mean keeping everyone waiting for an answer. Say what information you need and when you can decide. If circumstances change, revise the agreement openly. A high count cannot establish reserve, indecision, pessimism or strategic ability, and it is not permission to treat your own time or needs as less important than anyone else’s.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑承诺不必让所有人一直等。说需要哪些信息、何时可决定；情况变了，公开改约。高计数不确立内敛、犹豫、悲观或战略能力，也不允许把自己的时间需要看得比别人低。

title.en: Try naming a bounded responsibility
title.zh: 试着说清有范围的责任

paragraphs.en: Before accepting one optional task, write what you are choosing to do, what is outside the offer and when you will check back. Ask the other person whether that matches what they need. Afterwards, compare the agreement with the actual work. This is an experiment in clarity, not a measure of moral seriousness or a requirement to take on harder responsibilities.
paragraphs.zh: 接一次可选任务前，写愿做什么、哪些不包含、何时回看。问对方是否符合所需，之后比较约定与实际工作。这是在试清楚程度，不测道德认真，也不要求承担更难责任。

title.en: Nobara’s limited everyday angle
title.zh: 野蔷薇的有限日常角度

paragraphs.en: Nobara is a first-year student who comes to Tokyo in the first-season story setting. This edition chooses a limited angle of keeping a personal preference visible in shared work. It does not infer confidence, gender expression, appearance or how you respond to social pressure. A fictional comparison can invite a choice about a notebook cover without assigning an identity or a life decision to you.
paragraphs.zh: 第一季背景里的野蔷薇是一位来到东京的一年级学生。本版只选“在共同作品里保留可见的个人偏好”，不推断自信、性别表达、外貌或对社会压力的反应。人物比较可启发笔记本封面上的一个选择，不给你分派身份或人生决定。

title.en: The shared cover with one personal detail
title.zh: 共同封面上的一个个人细节

paragraphs.en: A group agrees on a style for a notebook cover. Within that agreement, you choose a colour, a small shape or a subject you genuinely like. You explain why you want to keep it and ask how it can fit with the other contributions. Personal expression can work inside a shared plan; it does not require rejecting the whole plan or winning every design choice.
paragraphs.zh: 小组约定笔记本封面风格，你在其中选真喜欢的颜色、小形状或主题。说明为什么想留，并问怎样与其他贡献配合。个人表达可以在共同计划内成立，不必拒绝整个计划，也不必赢每个设计选择。

title.en: Expression beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Yuji joins an attempt, Megumi selects a responsibility and Gojo changes the frame. Maki refines a technique and Toge clarifies wording and its effect. Nobara’s selected angle makes a personally chosen detail visible. These contributions can be combined without ranking originality, strength or authenticity. Another full guide can offer a useful comparison without becoming a more true or less true version of you.
paragraphs.zh: 悠仁加入尝试，惠选责任，悟换框架；真希打磨技法，棘说清措辞与影响。野蔷薇角度让亲自选的细节可见。可结合，不排名原创、力量或真实性。另一份全文可帮助比较，不成为更真或更假的你。

title.en: A preference is an offer, not a rule

paragraphs.en: A detail can matter to you while other people prefer a different version. State what you want without claiming everyone should share it, and ask where there is room to adapt. You may also decide a project is not for you. A high count does not prove stubbornness, self-esteem, independence or a particular gender role; a low count does not erase your individuality.
paragraphs.zh: 一个细节可对你重要，别人也可喜欢另一版。说想要什么，不主张人人都应同样，再问哪里可调整；也可决定不参加。高计数不证明固执、自尊、独立或某种性别角色，低计数不抹去个人差异。

title.en: Try naming one personal choice
title.zh: 试着认领一个个人选择

paragraphs.en: In one small creative task, name a choice you would enjoy keeping and one part you are happy to adapt. Invite a collaborator to do the same. Afterwards, notice whether both contributions remained recognisable. The exercise concerns the design agreement, not whether you are authentic enough, confident enough or obliged to resist someone else’s expectations.
paragraphs.zh: 一次小创作，说一个想保留的选择和一个愿调整的部分，请伙伴也这样做。之后看看双方贡献是否仍认得出。这关乎设计约定，不评是否够真实、够自信，也不要求反抗别人期待。

title.en: Gojo’s limited everyday angle

paragraphs.en: Gojo is a teacher at Tokyo Jujutsu High in the official first-season guide. This edition takes a limited editorial angle of showing an unfamiliar task through a different, sometimes playful example. It does not assess intelligence, power, teaching ability or charisma. Nothing in a craft preference establishes exceptional talent, superiority or the character’s supernatural position in the story.
paragraphs.zh: 官方第一季人物页里的悟是东京咒术高专教师。本版只取“用不同、有时带趣味的例子呈现陌生任务”的有限编辑角度，不评智力、力量、教学能力或魅力。手作偏好无法确立特殊天才、优越，或人物在剧情里的超自然地位。

title.en: A demonstration after the explanation stalls
title.zh: 解释停住后的一个演示

paragraphs.en: Everyone keeps explaining the same paper construction in the same words, but it still feels obscure. You try a different example that makes one relationship visible. Then you ask people to test it rather than admire the explanation. A useful reframe helps the learner engage with the task; it does not require an elaborate performance or a claim that the old method was foolish.
paragraphs.zh: 同一种纸结构一直用同样词解释，仍不清楚。你换例子，让其中一个关系可见，再请大家试，而不是欣赏讲解。好用的新角度帮助参与，不需要华丽表演，也不宣称旧方法愚蠢。

title.en: Reframing beside five other contributions
title.zh: 换角度与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Yuji offers company, Megumi clarifies a chosen commitment and Nobara keeps a personal expression. Maki gives a concrete technique time, while Toge attends to the meaning and effect of words. Gojo’s selected angle opens another route into understanding. All can support the same activity, without creating a hierarchy of teachers, learners, talent or potential from these raw counts.
paragraphs.zh: 悠仁陪伴，惠约清选择的承诺，野蔷薇保留个人表达；真希给具体技法时间，棘关注词语意思与影响。悟角度打开另一条理解路径。都可支持同一活动，不从原始次数构造教师、学习者、天分或潜力等级。

title.en: Check whether the new angle helps

paragraphs.en: A clever comparison can entertain without clarifying anything. Ask which part became easier to see, and return to a plain demonstration if needed. People can prefer a familiar method or decline your help. A high count cannot establish creativity, unconventional thinking or professional teaching competence, and a lower count does not mean you lack imagination.
paragraphs.zh: 巧妙比较可以有趣，却没讲清任何事。问哪部分更明白，需要时回到平实示范。别人可喜欢熟悉方法，也可拒绝帮助。高计数不确立创造力、非常规思维或专业教学能力，低计数不表示没想象。

title.en: Try one alternative and compare it

paragraphs.en: For one harmless task, show a brief alternative example and invite a willing person to try both explanations. Ask what each made clear and what remained confusing. Keep the simpler version if it works better. This is feedback on examples in one situation, not evidence of a superior mind, a fixed learning style or a duty to lead others.
paragraphs.zh: 一次无害任务，展示简短替代例子，请愿意的人试两种说明。问各讲清了什么、还困惑什么；简单版本更好就保留简单版。这是具体例子的反馈，不证明头脑更优、固定学习风格，也不要求领导别人。

This edition independently selects the ordinary idea of practising a concrete technique. It does not infer physical strength, discipline, resilience, talent or a family history like hers. A count from preference questions cannot establish how well you perform, what training you need or what limits you can overcome.
paragraphs.zh: 第一季人物背景中的真希是与咒具使用有关的二年级学生。本版独立选练具体技法这个普通想法，不推断体力、自律、韧性、天分或相同家庭经历。偏好题计数无法确立实际做得多好、需何种训练、能克服哪些限制。

title.en: The one fold you want to understand
title.zh: 想弄明白的那一道折法

paragraphs.en: A paper model has one awkward fold. You give that small movement a short practice round, changing one detail and observing the result. You can stop, ask for a demonstration or choose another activity. Deliberate practice in this example is about a bounded hobby attempt, not proving that effort always succeeds or that someone should endure discomfort to earn a place.
paragraphs.zh: 纸模型有一道不顺手的折法。你给小动作一轮短练习，每次改一个细节，看结果。也可停、请人示范或换活动。这里的专注练习只是有范围的兴趣尝试，不证明努力总成功，也不要求忍受不适来争取位置。

title.en: Practice beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Yuji joins the attempt, Megumi chooses a responsibility and Nobara preserves a personal detail. Gojo tries another frame while Toge clarifies the message. Maki’s selected angle works directly on one concrete action. These roles can move between people as the activity changes. A higher count does not make practice your only useful contribution or rank your actual skill above anyone else’s.
paragraphs.zh: 悠仁加入尝试，惠选责任，野蔷薇留个人细节；悟换框架，棘讲清表达。真希角度直接练一个具体动作。活动变化，分工可在人之间转移。高计数不让练习成为唯一有用贡献，也不把实际技能排在别人上面。

title.en: Effort needs a useful limit
title.zh: 投入也需要好用的上限

paragraphs.en: Repeating a step is not automatically helpful when the instructions are unclear or the materials do not fit. Change the setup, ask for information or take a break. You can enjoy practising without making persistence a moral obligation. A high count cannot establish grit, perfectionism or a real ability level, and a lower count is not evidence of laziness or lack of potential.
paragraphs.zh: 说明不清或材料不合时，重复未必有用。换准备、补信息或休息；可享受练习，不把坚持变成道德义务。高计数不确立毅力、完美主义或真实能力等级，低计数不证明懒惰或没潜力。

title.en: Try a small change you can observe
title.zh: 试一个能观察的小改动

paragraphs.en: Choose one harmless hobby action and give it a few minutes. Change only one small part, then describe what happened without turning it into a judgement about yourself. Decide whether another attempt would be enjoyable or useful. The exercise concerns this action and setup; it is not a performance assessment, training prescription or guarantee that practice will remove every barrier.
paragraphs.zh: 选一个无害兴趣动作，给几分钟，只改一处，再描述发生什么，不转成对自己的评价。决定再试是否愉快、有用。这只关乎动作与准备，不是表现评估、训练处方，也不保证练习能移除所有障碍。

title.en: Toge’s limited everyday angle

paragraphs.en: Toge is a second-year student whose fictional cursed speech shapes how he communicates in the first-season setting. This edition selects a separate, ordinary angle of considering what a message means and how it may land. It does not equate your words with supernatural danger or infer silence, a communication disorder, self-sacrifice or any private reason for speaking in a particular way.
paragraphs.zh: 第一季背景里的棘是二年级学生，虚构咒言影响其交流方式。本版另选普通角度：考虑消息是什么意思、可能怎样被接收。不把你的话等同超自然危险，也不推断沉默、沟通障碍、自我牺牲或某种说话方式背后的私人原因。

title.en: A suggestion that could sound like an order
title.zh: 可能听起来像命令的建议

paragraphs.en: You want to suggest a change to a shared craft, but a short message could sound like an instruction everyone must obey. You describe what you noticed, mark the idea as a suggestion and ask whether feedback is welcome. Clear wording gives people a way to respond. It cannot ensure the message will be received exactly as intended, and disagreement need not mean the words were harmful.
paragraphs.zh: 你想给共同手作提改动，但短消息可能像人人必须服从的指令。说具体看见什么，标明只是建议，再问是否欢迎反馈。清楚措辞给人回应办法，却不能保证完全按原意接收；不同意也未必表示话有害。

title.en: Words beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Yuji offers company for a next step, Megumi clarifies a commitment and Nobara keeps a personal choice. Gojo finds another frame and Maki works on a concrete technique. Toge’s selected angle attends to what is said and what it promises. All can support the same project without ranking compassion, restraint or communication ability, and every highest tie retains its full comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 悠仁陪下一步，惠约承诺，野蔷薇留个人选择；悟换框架，真希练具体技法。棘角度关注说了什么、承诺什么。都可支持同一项目，不排名慈悲、克制或沟通能力；每个最高并列保留完整比较。

title.en: Careful does not have to mean wordless

paragraphs.en: You can be direct and considerate at the same time. Ask for clarification when a message is ambiguous rather than assuming you know another person’s reaction. You do not have to review every ordinary sentence endlessly. A high count cannot establish fear of conflict, sensitivity or moral purity, and a lower count does not prove that your words are careless or unsafe.
paragraphs.zh: 直接和体贴可同时成立。消息含糊时问清，不假设知道别人反应；也不用无尽审查每句日常话。高计数不确立害怕冲突、敏感或道德纯洁，低计数不证明措辞粗心或不安全。

title.en: Try checking one concrete message
title.zh: 试着核对一条具体消息

paragraphs.en: Before sending one optional project note, check what it asks, whom it represents and whether it makes a promise you intend to keep. If needed, ask a collaborator how they read it. Afterwards, compare the response with your intended meaning. This is feedback about one message, not an assessment of speech, empathy or responsibility for everyone’s feelings.
paragraphs.zh: 发一次可选项目便条前，检查要求什么、代表谁、是否作了真打算履行的承诺。需要时问伙伴怎样读，之后比较回应和原意。这是一条消息的反馈，不评言语、共情，也不要求对所有人感受负责。
